root: ^You can move around by using the [WASD] keys in your keyboard, or the left analogue on your gamepad!
^To look around, move your mouse or use the right analogue on your gamepad!
^Tap the button while moving to perform a dodge roll. This allows you to avoid any damage, at the cost of some stamina.
^ Tap the button while stopped to perform a backstep.
^Hold the above buttons to run faster! In the gamepad, you can alternatively press the left analogue while moving to sprint.
^ Your stamina will drain while you sprint.
^Tap the button to perform a light attack.
^ How much your stamina will drain will depend on the weapon equipped
^Tap the button to perform an heavy attack.
^ Heavy attacks deal more damage than light attacks, but they drain more stamina as well.
^Jumping allows you to reach higher heights.
^ Be careful not to jump off from a great height, because you will take fall damage!
^Tap the attack button after jumping to perform a jumping attack! You can also perform it when falling from a height and tapping the attack button.
^Tap the attack button while sprinting to perform a sprint attack!
^Tap to lock the camera on to an enemy (also known as z-target). This allows you to focus on a specific target during combat.
^When facing multiple enemies, you can alternate between your current lock on target by gently moving your mouse to the left / right of the current target,
^or move the right analogue button left or right, depending on the target you which to switch the lock on to.
^You can equip certain items on the main menu to quickly access them during game.
^Upward Slot: Used to switch skills / spells
^Downward Slot: Used to switch consumables (like potions)
^Right: Used to switch weapons equipped in the right hand
^Left: Used to switch weapons equipped in the left hand
^Press [2] or the up arrow key in your keyboard, or the up button in the directional pad on the gamepad to switch skills / spells.
^Press the [Q] key or the [L2] button pictured above to cast a skill / spell.
^Spells are powerful tools in your arsenal that benefit from the Intelligence stat, which you can level up at a bonfire.
^Casting a skill / spell will almost always drain mana.
^Press [4] or the down arrow key in your keyboard, or the down button in the directional pad on the gamepad to switch between consumables.
^ You can equip potions, fire bombs, weapon resins (which buff weapons with elemental damage), among other types of consumables.
^Press the [R] key or the gamepad button pictured above to use the current consumable.
^Press [3] or the right arrow key in your keyboard, or the right button in the directional pad on the gamepad to switch between weapons for the right hand.
^ You can equip up to 3 weapons at a time for your right hand!
^Press [1] or the left arrow key in your keyboard, or the left button in the directional pad on the gamepad to switch between weapons for the left hand.
^ You can equip up to 3 weapons at a time for your left hand!
